roleTitle: Staff Development and Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as a Staff Development and Infection Control Nurse. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and competency with robust infection prevention strategies, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and team.

In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in fostering a culture of continuous learning and vigilance against healthcare-associated infections. Your expertise will directly impact staff performance, regulatory compliance, and overall patient outcomes. We offer a competitive hourly rate for this impactful position.

If you are an RN passionate about education, quality improvement, and infection control, and are ready to make a significant contribution to a supportive healthcare environment, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of nursing experience, preferably in a long-term care or rehabilitation setting
Demonstrated experience in staff education/development or infection control practices
Strong understanding of infection prevention protocols and regulatory compliance
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

description: An exciting and confidential opportunity awaits a dedicated Marketing Director at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This recently purchased facility is seeking a dynamic and results-oriented professional to drive community engagement and census growth. The ideal candidate will be presentable, proactive, and willing to work occasional weekends to achieve success. This role offers significant potential for impact within a growing organization. We are looking for a 'hustler' who is eager to make a substantial contribution and will be compensated well for their expertise and drive.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, ideally within a skilled nursing or healthcare setting
Ability to work occasional weekends to meet business needs
Demonstrated strong presentation and interpersonal skills
A proactive and results-driven approach to marketing and community outreach
Strong understanding of healthcare marketing strategies and census development
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience. Pays well for the right person.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated Full-time Occupational Therapist (OT) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL. This critical role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on patients' lives, providing essential therapy services in a supportive and dynamic environment.

As an Occupational Therapist, you will be responsible for developing and implementing individualized treatment plans to help patients regain independence and improve their quality of life. We are looking for a compassionate professional ready to contribute to a team-oriented setting and deliver exceptional patient care.

This position offers a competitive hourly rate, reflecting the importance of this role and the expertise required. Join a facility committed to excellence in rehabilitation.
requirements: Current state licensure as an Occupational Therapist (OT)
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work full-time hours
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $48.00 based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Family Medicine Physician to join a premier family health center in Greenville, SC. This role offers a highly competitive compensation package starting at $210,000 annually, complemented by a robust bonus structure that can reach up to $50,000, including relocation and sign-on incentives. We value our team members and provide excellent benefits, including generous Paid Time Off.

This position is open to various contract types, including Part-time, PRN, and Contract, though full-time candidates are preferred. We are actively reviewing all qualified Physician candidates, including those open to travel or relocation, to find the right fit for our dynamic environment. Join a team committed to providing exceptional patient care and enjoy a supportive work-life balance.
salaryShort: $210,000 per year + up to $50,000 in bonuses
requirements: Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification or Eligibility in Family Medicine (preferred), Internal Medicine, or Med/Pediatrics
Openness to travel or relocation for the position
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts at $210,000 per year, with a guaranteed bonus of $25,000 and an additional potential bonus of $25,000, totaling up to $50,000 in bonuses. $9,000 of the bonus structure is available as a sign-on/relocation bonus, with $9,000 payable on day one upon signing a promissory note.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced PM&R Physician to join a premier health and rehabilitation network across three locations in Brooklyn, NY. This role offers a highly competitive compensation package starting at $300,000 annually, with a strong emphasis on performance-based bonuses.

The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced environment focused exclusively on workers' compensation, no-fault, and lien cases. This is a unique opportunity for a physician who is passionate about rehabilitation and committed to providing exceptional care within this specialized patient population. Weekend availability is a key requirement for this position.
requirements: Board Certified in Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation (PM&R)
WCB (Workers' Compensation Board) certified
Minimum of 2 years of experience with workers' compensation, no-fault, or lien cases
Ability to work weekends
Comfortable working exclusively with workers' compensation, no-fault, and lien cases (no major medical, Medicare, or Medicaid)
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts at $300,000 annually, with a very heavy emphasis on bonuses and less on base salary.
